body:
#4308 (S1t-b) round 2 is pushed at b35b3b5 and relabeled ci:full. Ready for the STRICT re-review. All of F1 to F6 are addressed:
- F1: VerifiedTrainMerge::enforce runs train_recheck first, then again as the last step after the refresh, corpus and head reads, immediately before the transport.
- F2: the manual-train handler and train_recheck both use load_checked. Malformed config refuses; there is no ci-gated default.
- F3: an untrusted authorship ledger (missing, unreadable or malformed) refuses the cars' author rule; it no longer just warns.
- F4: four tests through merge_train_change and enforce on the real bug2406 fixture in review-gated mode with an advisor grant:
  - a valid grant merges (one pinned call);
  - a grant revoked during the refresh's CI read, after the first recheck, refuses with no merge call; mutation-checked: removing the late enforce->train_recheck call makes this test fail;
  - a base move refuses;
  - a corrupt ledger refuses.
  There is also a unit test for malformed config.
- F5: the boarded refusal names `aida pr train --status` and the exact `aida pr train --abandon <journal-file>`, and the test asserts both.
- F6: the duplicate paragraphs are removed.
Checks: 105 targeted tests pass (story_2905, merge_claim, bug2406, story_2903), and headless check-ci-fast exited 0.
